problem:
Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -1 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

The parallelogram $P$ is mapped to the parallelogram ${P}^{′}$ under the action of $T.$ The parallelogram ${P}^{′}$ has vertices $(0,0),(-2,-2),(-4,0),$ and $(-2,2).$ Which of the following are vertices of $P?$

- $(2,2)$
- $(0,1)$
- $(-2,0)$
